ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black) pixels covering approximately 98% of the surface area, with isolated high-intensity (white) pixel clusters at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A single contiguous geometric mass of black pixels occupying the main body of the fluke; two distinct, roughly circular high-contrast white clusters mapped to the extreme terminal ends of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, wide V-shaped median notch with a wide angle and minimal depth penetration relative to the overall fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the central trailing edge; increased pixel-amplitude variations (jaggedness) visible at the far outer edges adjacent to the white tip clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upper boundary (trailing edge) follows a broad concave curve sweeping upwards and outwards; lower boundary (leading edge) presents as a mostly linear taper from the center to the acute points at the lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized high-contrast white markings at the extreme lateral tips, likely representing barnacle scarring or depigmented trauma sites.
other_distinctive_markers: The fluke exhibits a nearly uniform 'Type 5' pigmentation profile (entirely black) except for the terminal tips.
